_readme: The big competitions. Each one is held once a season (a season is 120 days) at its track: 24 dogs run in 4 heats, the first 3 in each heat go into 2 semi-finals, and the first 3 in each semi make the final. classKey is the kind of race: sprint, standard or stay. dayInSeason is roughly when the heats are run (moved to the track's next racing night). entryFee is what you pay to enter a dog. prizes are for 1st to 6th in the final. Change names, fees and prizes freely; keep the quotes and commas.
